items.problem: Project root namespace equals a WinRT type (project scaffolded under the sample's own API name), so every simple-name reference in the migrated source binds to the app's namespace instead of the type → CS0118 x9 + XAML WMC9999. Whole build fails; score 0/100.
items.evidence: migration-score.json build_error: 9x CS0118 'Accelerometer' is a namespace but is used like a type + XamlCompiler WMC9999; session-log.txt L1290/1364/1394 (scaffold 'namespace Accelerometer' vs source 'namespace SDKTemplate'); csproj <RootNamespace>Accelerometer</RootNamespace>.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap leaves the scaffold's default root namespace (== project name) in place. When that name equals a type the source references by simple name, C# resolves the simple name to the namespace, not the type.
items.change: Added a namespace/type collision guard (section 3b) to Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: if the scaffold root namespace appears as a bare identifier in the copied source, rename the scaffold root namespace to <Name>App — updating <RootNamespace>, scaffold-owned namespace declarations, x:Class, and xmlns:local. Copied source keeps its original namespace and is never modified. Summary block prints a 'Root namespace guard' line. Also added a SKILL.md Step 0 note so the agent keeps the renamed namespace.
items.expected_effect: Scaffolded projects whose name collides with a WinRT type are renamed at bootstrap, so simple-name type references resolve correctly and the project compiles.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run on a type-named sample (Accelerometer/Compass/Gyrometer/Barometer): bootstrap prints 'Root namespace guard: <Name> -> <Name>App'; csproj RootNamespace + scaffold x:Class use <Name>App; 'dotnet build' emits 0 CS0118 'is a namespace but is used like a type' and no WMC9999.
